title: ProjectionCoverage
description: Projection cache and lag aggregate for a doorway. Source of truth: doorway projection cache + REA observation events (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

projectedCidCount.description: Number of CIDs the doorway is currently projecting.

knownCidCount.description: Total CIDs the doorway is aware of (projected + known but unprojected).

projectionLagMsAvg.description: Average milliseconds between source observation and projection ack over last 24h.
